notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Version 1.051 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

After this week's substantial mid-week update, we have a relatively small patch for the weekend, but an exciting one nonetheless! This update brings trait tool-tips for player characters, as well as some other small fixes. You can read the details below:

[h3]New In This Build:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Player Trait Tool-tips:[/b] Mousing over a trait icon on the character panel will now display the trait description. This currently only works for player characters, as it is not currently possible to mouse over enemy trait icons. We are looking into the best ways to display enemy trait information, and we should have a solution soon-ish.
[*][b]Terrifying Trait:[/b] A new aggro trait has been added; Terrifying. Characters with the Terrifying trait have the lowest priority when the AI chooses a target. The two scariest heroes have had their Intimidating trait replaced with Terrifying.
[*][b]Enraged Savagery Icon Update:[/b] A new trait icon has been added for the Enraged Savagery trait.
[*][b]Nameless Beast Lorebook Clues Update:[/b] The lore fragments detailing how to find the Nameless Beast have been updated, and the method should now be clearer.
[*][b]Nameless Heart Item Description Update:[/b] The item description for the Nameless Heart has been updated.
[*][b]Herald Delve Dialogue Update:[/b] The Delve dialogue lines for the Herald have had a small update.
[/list]
Thank you for reading, and we'll see you in the next update! Until then, may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be glorious!

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Version 1.050 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We're back with another mid-week update, and this one brings quite a few changes. Normally we try to keep the patch notes as close to spoiler-free as possible, but there's no way around some major spoilers this time. Read on at your peril. You have been warned!

[h3]New In This Build:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Abyss Delve Victory Tile Fix:[/b] There was a bug causing only three victory tiles to spawn in some Abyss Delve levels, potentially preventing parties of four characters from completing a run. This has now been fixed ([i]or at least, I really hope it has! - Daniel[/i]).
[*][b]True Final Boss Deployment Fix:[/b] There was a bug where the deployment tiles were not spawning at the start of the true final boss fight, preventing changes to the default party. This has been fixed.
[*][b]True Final Boss Glory Readout Fix:[/b] The true final boss fight was displaying a Glory reward of 0 on the world map. This has been fixed.
[*][b]Movement Point Crash Fix:[/b] There was a bug that caused the game to crash if a character exceeded 15 available Movement Points. Although unlikely to occur, this could affect some end-game party compositions. The bug has been fixed.
[*][b]Combat UI Update:[/b] The combat UI has been updated to make room for more trait icons in preparation for trait tooltips. Player and enemy characters will now also display their equipped Boon under their name in the combat UI.
[*][b]Shared Frenzy Update:[/b] The Gladiator rework has begun, and the first phase is... a buff. The Shared Frenzy skill now also removes the Stunned and Off-Balance conditions from allies when it triggers. This is the first part of an overhaul to the trait, and the Gladiator Boon as a whole. Don't worry, it will be scaled down to be slightly less ridiculous soon, and other end-game Boons will be getting some upgrades to introduce some more interesting choices to end-game party building.
[*][b]Herald (Darkbringer):[/b] Speaking of end-game Boons, the Herald has just received one of its own. The Herald was pretty underwhelming in post-game content, and this new Boon should more than rectify that. The Darkbringer Boon can only be unlocked by completing the story campaign, and is a nod to the Easter egg at the end of the final cutscene. In addition to the lore ramifications, the Darkbringer Boon is just also really powerful. With it the Herald gains the ability to harm even stone Unborn, the ability to break barriers with its melee attack, and the ability to drain life when it deals damage. Combined with its already formidable set of skills and traits, the Darkbringer Boon turns the Herald into an absolute monster ideally suited to hunting down the true final boss.
[*][b]Herald Teleport Fix:[/b] There was a bug causing the victory conditions to not be checked after the Herald teleported, potentially meaning that all your characters would be standing on victory tiles, but that the victory would not register until you ended your turn. Not a big issue, but still annoying. This is now fixed.
[*][b]Giant (Giant Lord):[/b] The Giant has also received its end-game Boon in the form of the Giant Lord. The Giant Lord Boon is a significant upgrade that grants the Giant a massive health pool, even higher damage on its club smash, and a surprising amount of mobility. The Giant should now feel like a much more useful team member, even on the hardest Delve levels.
[*][b]Rakshasa Hero Update:[/b] The Rakshasa hero is an absolute powerhouse, but its slow attacks and limited action points make it slightly awkward as a solo character when compared to Sahatus, the only other Delve hero to take up three party slots. To make the Rakshasa feel more worthwhile, we have reduced its cost to two party slots, making it much easier to include in late-game Delve parties.
[*][b]Rakshasa (Great Fiend) Fix:[/b] The Rakshasa's end-game boon, the Great Fiend, was displaying incorrect unlock requirements. This has now been fixed.
[*][b]Misc:[/b] Fixed a couple more typos!
[/list]
That's all for now! We'll see you in the next update. Until then, thank you for reading, and may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be glorious!

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Version 1.040 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

This update brings some more bug fixes and gameplay tweaks. You can find a full list of the changes below:

[h3]New In This Build:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Death Frenzy / Shared Frenzy: [/b]Fixed a bug where the extra movement and action points granted by the Death Frenzy and Shared Frenzy traits would be lost when resetting a move.
[*][b]Combat UI: [/b]Fixed a bug that made is possible to click on player characters through the combat UI.
[*][b]Title Screen: [/b]Fixed some flickering and layering issues with the grass on the title screen.
[*][b]Lorebook: [/b]Fixed a bug where a [i]rather important[/i] Lorebook entry was turning up too early.
[*][b]Boons: [/b]Updated the names of starting boons to (hopefully) make early-game progression a little clearer. Fixed a typo in the descriptions for the Gut Charge skills.
[*][b]Dialogue: [/b]Fixed a couple of typos in the dialogue for Chapter 8.
[*][b]Rematch I: [/b]Fixed a bug where it was possible to double the number of enemies that spawned in Rematch I by skipping the dialogue within the first couple of frames of the level loading.
[/list]

[h3]Up Next:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Final Boss Update: [/b]The final boss will be undergoing a revamp at some point in the (relatively) near future, with an eye to making the fight more varied and challenging.
[*][b]Cloud Saves: [/b]Steam Cloud saves should be ready to go pretty soon.
[*][b]Avenger / Gladiator Rework: [/b]We're mostly happy with the Avenger Boon path overall, and probably won't be making any drastic changes, but the Gladiator is much too powerful when compared to other end-game Outlander Boons. The rework will aim to balance the Gladiator, as well as adjusting it to better fit its theme. We will also set the Avenger and Gladiator Boons back to their normal price when the rework goes live.
[*][b]New Guardian Boons: [/b]The Guardian is currently missing her fourth Boon path. We are aiming to add it soon! When we do, it will likely be available at a reduced Glory cost for the first week or so, much like the Avenger.
[*][b]Combat UI Update: [/b]An update is coming for the combat UI, which will make more room for traits, add trait tooltips, and (probably) include some indication of which Boon a character has equipped.
[/list]

Thank you for reading, and we will see you in the next update! Until then, may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be glorious!

EDIT: Just realized that I missed a couple of entries for the patch notes. Fixed now. - Daniel

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn 1.032 - Patch Notes

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Version 1.030 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

This update isn't part of the normal release schedule, but it is something we've been wanting to add for a while. We're currently taking a look at character progression in Guile & Glory: Firstborn, and considering some changes to the Boon system. No promises on the details yet, but we'll probably be making some tweaks over the next little while.
[h3]
New In This Build:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Outlander (Avenger): [/b]This new Boon path for the Outlander grants the Death Frenzy skill, allowing him to gain additional movement and action points whenever he defeats an enemy. The Avenger Boon will be available at a greatly-reduced Glory price for a short while, as we are eager for people to try it and give us some feedback.
[*] [b]Outlander (Gladiator): [/b]The Gladiator is a new endgame boon for the Outlander, unlocking by maxing out the Avenger and Tactician Boon paths. The Gladiator is an extremely powerful Boon that allows the Outlander to grant the Death Frenzy trait to his allies as well. The Gladiator will also be available at a much cheaper Glory price for a short time.
[*] [b]Scoundrel (Accursed): [/b]We are currently rethinking the way Boons are unlocked and improved, and we have removed the additional requirements from the Scoundrel's Accursed Boon path for now.
[*] [b]Lorebook - Help Section: [/b]We have also fixed a couple of typos in the Help section of the Lorebook.
[*] [b]Known Issues: [/b]We are aware of an issue with the text in the description of the Shared Frenzy trait. It should be fixed in the next few hours.
[/list]

Expect a fix for the text issue in the next few hours, and another small update over the weekend. Until then, may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be glorious!

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Version 1.020 - Patch Notes

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Version 1.010 - Patch Notes

Hi Everyone!

As promised, the missing Boons for Delve heroes are live in this patch. All unlockable characters now have some form of progression that should help keep them relevant in late-game and post-game content.

The fourth playable character and every Delve hero can now be upgraded for better stats, new skills and / or new traits, allowing for powerful new party compositions in later-game Delves.

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn - Release V 1.00
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

This is it! Guile & Glory: Firstborn is now complete and out of Steam Early Access! This doesn't necessarily spell the end of development, but all the core features are complete, so it felt like the right time to transition to full release.

[h3]State of the Game:[/h3]
As of right now, the game includes the following content:

[list]
[*] 45 Story missions
[*] 4 Playable heroes
[*] 6 Bonus unlockable heroes for Delves
[*] 50 Unlockable Lorebook entries
[*] Character Progression
[*] Delves - a randomised dungeon mode spanning 36 floors, 56 combat scenarios and 8 boss fights!
[/list]

[h3]Post-Launch Content:[/h3]
The core of the game is finished and ready to roll, including all the story missions, as well as optional and post-game content. We do have at least one major update planned as of now, which will bring Steam achievements at the very least, and probably a few more bits and pieces. I'll keep you posted!

[h3]Regarding Boons:[/h3]
A number of the unlockable characters are currently missing their Boons in the release build. Don't panic! We caught a couple of bugs last minute, but the missing Boons will be releasing in a hotfix over the weekend.

[h3]A Note on Pricing:[/h3]
If you've been keeping up with development, you will have noticed that we have gone live, but the price has not increased as expected. That one's on me. I made a mistake setting things up with the launch discount. Long story short, the dreaded price increase is (probably) still coming, but not today! For now, you can get the game at the Early Access price. We'll also be running a small discount in conjunction with PAX Aus Online, so keep an eye out for that over the weekend!

[h3]What Comes Next:[/h3]
Leaving Early Access is a huge milestone for the project, but there will likely be more to do. I expect we'll be releasing a few smaller patches before the achievement update, and DLC or expansion content definitely isn't off the cards. We'll have a lot to talk about in the coming weeks! For now, though, launching a game is a lot of work, and this game dev needs a nap.

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Early Access 8.50 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

The 8.50 update for the Early Access build of Guile & Glory: Firstborn brings quite a few changes. It might also be the last one before full release. I guess that depends on how many bugs we find in the coming days. You can find a list of the changes below, and we're also finally ready to talk about what you can expect in terms of content and pricing once the game leaves Early Access. Exciting stuff! Let's get started.

[h2]Early Access 8.50 - Patch Notes:[/h2]
[b]Under the Hood:[/b]
The majority of the changes made as part of this patch will not be immediately visible, but will be essential to ensure that the full release version functions as intended and provides the best possible experience. I have tidied up a lot of interactions between skills and mechanics that do not normally encounter each other in a story playthrough. I will go into the reasons for this later in the blog. Notably, I have also stripped out a bunch of old legacy files from earlier versions of the project, then run through to (hopefully) make sure that the removal of those files doesn't cause any issues. Let me be very clear; no playable content has been removed. The deleted files were old levels and objects that are no longer compatible with the current version of the game.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where opening the Heroes tab of the Lorebook was crashing the game. Yikes!
[/list]
[b]Characters:[/b]
[list]
[*] All unlockable Delve characters now have aggro modifiers like the story characters, making it clearer which party members will be prioritised by attacking enemies.
[*] The Guardian's magic bolts with now deal the correct amount of damage to the Wyrm after absorbing additional Essence Orbs.
[*] The Outlander now uses the correct animation for the Dash skill when equipped with the Berserker III Boon.
[/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some typos.
[*] Tooltips now scale in size to match the length of the description, and should look better overall.
[*] Replaced some fonts that didn't quite look right in a couple of the menus.
[*] Locked Boons now display their Glory cost as well as their statistics and traits, making it easier to plan out how you spend your Glory.
[*] Locked Essence Orb interaction skills (such as the Guardian's Absorbing Bolt) now use the correct icon in the Traits readout.
[/list]
[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*] Chapter 2 - Level 2 was kind of unsightly, and has received a beauty pass.
[*] A number of levels have been tweaked to prevent the cinematic bars from obstructing the view of characters during dialogue.
[*] I discovered that it was possible to kill the Rakshasa this first time it is encountered by the Outlander and Scoundrel, as its rage mechanic was not triggering correctly in that battle if its health fell to 7 or below. The Rakshasa will now become enraged as normal after taking 3 damage.
[/list]
[b]Delves:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Victory Menu at the end of a Delve area will now only show the option to claim your rewards, to prevent confusion.
[*] The dialogue systems for Delves has been updated so that enemies will not repeat lines at the start of a battle.
[*] The victory quotes for Sahatus have been updated.
[/list]
[h2]Release & Beyond- What to Expect:[/h2]
[b]Release Version Changes:[/b]
The current Early Access build of Guile & Glory: Firstborn contains all of the story content, but there will still be some new stuff dropping when we leave Early Access. The introductory levels are being reworked to give players a better idea of the Outlander's story at the outset. The Delve mode is also being expanded significantly, with all unlockable characters gaining at least a few purchasable upgrades, and new Delve regions being added for the Road of Kings and the Abyss. 

These new Delves will allow players to pit their unlocked heroes against versions of the story bosses, while also providing a substantial source of Glory. For the most dedicated players who complete both the story and the Delves, there will a new endgame challenge in the Sanctum of Ruin, a nightmarishly-difficult battle that allows you to pit any of your unlocked heroes against Guile & Glory's most formidable antagonist yet. 

Finally, Jessie is working on a sweet new title screen, and Landon has a delightful surprise in store for when the credits roll. I won't be spoiling that one. You'll just have to save the Drowned Lands and find out...

[b]Pricing:[/b]
We will be increasing the price of the game a bit when we leave Early Access, but we will also be running a launch sale, so I suspect it will work out about the same whether you pick it up now or at launch. On the one hand, I obviously want to encourage anyone who is interested to pick up the project at launch, because every purchase helps me keep making games for all of you, and enables me to bring in incredibly talented contractors like Jessie and Landon to do more cool stuff. On the other hand, though, I've also tried to be fair and transparent with the pricing at every stage of development, so if you do miss the launch sale, don't stress. There will be others.

[b]Post-Launch Content:[/b]
At this stage, we have one major post-launch update planned. The update will add Steam achievements, a bunch of additional Lorebook items to discover, and (hopefully) cloud saves and a functional Linux build of the game.

Whew! That was a long one! Thank you for reading, and may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be Glorious! See you at launch... or possibly in like a day or two if something breaks before then.

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Early Access 8.10 & PAX Aus
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The latest update brings a range of fixes and improvements for the 8.0 Early Access release. This update should address most of the bugs found in the last update, as well as expanding a number of the core systems to pretty much their final version. You can find a breakdown of the latest patch below, but first...
[h2]
PAX Aus Online 2021[/h2]
We are delighted to be participating in the digital PAX Aus event for 2021. We will be releasing an update in conjunction with the event, so stay tuned for more news on that, and we'll look forward to seeing you in the digital expo hall from the 8th to the 10th of October! Now, on to the patch notes for the 8.10 update!

[h2]Early Access 8.10 Patch Notes (Warning: Minor Spoilers):[/h2]

[h3]Boons Menu:[/h3]
The Boons menu has been updated so that locked boons are now visible, and locked skills show their full description. It is now much easier to decide which boons you want each of your characters to specialise in, and which endgame paths with work best for your playstyle. Additionally, when selecting a boon in the menu, you will be shown how that boon's HP, Action Points and Movement Points compare to the statistics of the one you currently have equipped on that character.

[h3]Essence Orbs:[/h3]
Many playable characters now have new ways of interacting with Essence Orbs. These changes were introduced to improve the Delve experience with different team compositions, and facilitate some new content coming with the full release version:
[list]
[*] [b]Guardian:[/b] The Guardian's bolts will now absorb any additional Essence Orbs they collide with, increasing the damage of the bolt for each Orb absorbed. Additionally, to bonus damage from absorbed Essence Orbs ignores the Barrier status effect.
[*] [b]Herald / Cyclops / Turtleclops:[/b] Melee character can now move Essence Orbs by hitting them with anattack. An Essence Orb knocked into a character in this way will explode and deal damage, as normal.
[*] [b]Cyclops Archer:[/b] The Cyclops Archer's arrows will now absorb Essence Orbs that they pass through, gaining additional damage that will pierce through Barriers, much like the Guardian's energy bolts.
[*] [b]Giant / Rakshasa:[/b] Energy blasts created by the Giant and Rakshasa playable character will now absorb Essence Orbs, gaining additional damage that can bypass the Barrier status.
[*] [b]Sahatus:[/b] Using Dark Summons on an Essence Orb will now destroy the Orb, granting Sahatus the Barrier condition until the end of his next turn. Each additional Orb consumed increases the duration by 1 turn.
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
In addition to a range of minor tweaks and bug fixes, the following miscellaneous changes have been made:
[list]
[*] [b]Scoundrel:[/b] The Vanquisher Boon now has the Sprint II skill. The Assassin Boon now grants a base movement of 6, and the Exploit Weakness III Trait. The Confounding Bomb skill now knocks any large target Off-Balance, per the skill description.
[*] [b]Guardian:[/b] The Seraph Boon now grants a base movement of 6, and the Swift Blessing II Trait.
[*] [b]Giant: [/b]The Giant now costs 2 party slots in Delves, as indicated in the character selection menu.
[*] [b]Cyclops Archer:[/b] Added a skill description when firing the bow.
[*] [b]Turtleclops:[/b] Added a character description.
[*] [b]Sahatus:[/b] Blade of Ruin now removes the Barrier condition from targets struck.
[*] [b]Essence Orbs:[/b] Are now immune to all damage, as originally intended.
[*] [b]Boons:[/b] Now show any special Essence Orb interactions as a Trait.
[*] [b]Tooltips:[/b] Are now displayed in a clearer font, and the size of the pop-up now scales to the length of the text.
[*] [b]Combat UI:[/b] When mousing over a potential target with a skill selected, the Push and Pull indicators will now show clearer information.
[*] [b]Stoneborn:[/b] Stoneborn now correctly spawn stone chips at the start of the battle, allowing an astute player to distinguish them from normal statues.
[*] [b]Projectiles: [/b]Projectile explosions are now longer offset incorrectly when striking the boundaries of the map.
[/list]

[h2]What Comes Next?[/h2]
We're getting very close to the final release version of Guile & Glory: Firstborn, but there is still more work to do. Stay tuned for further updates in the next few weeks! Thank you for reading, and may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be Glorious!

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Early Access 8.03 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Just a small patch to address a couple of minor bugs we discovered during in-house testing of Chapter 8. Additionally, if the Guardian is using a Boon that grants Reactive Block, she will now block impacts with walls and other terrain to prevent herself being stunned.

Also introduced a small tweak to the portrait for the boss in the last battle of Chapter 8.

The final battles should be more or less bug-free now (fingers crossed), but they aren't any easier. Good luck, Aspirants!

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn - Early Acces Version 8.02 Full Campaign Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

It's been a tough year, but I have some good news. I know I've been quiet for a while, but I haven't been idle. The game is pretty close to finished now, and there's a lot of new content to experience.

I'll include a breakdown of all the changes below, but you can also just jump in and give it a try if you don't want any spoilers.

Thank you all for bearing with me, and I hope you enjoy the update!

-Daniel


[i][b]Note:[/b] This update overhauls almost everything in the game, which unfortunately means that old saves are no longer supported. If you attempt to load an old save file, you will keep any acquired Glory, but your story progress and Lorebook unlocks will be reset.[/i]

[h3][b]Tiny Teams Festival 2021[/b][/h3]
Before we get into the game updates, I also wanted to mention that we're very proud to be included in the Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival 2021. The festival is a fantastic showcase of upcoming indie games with teams of five or fewer developers. It's definitely worth checking out, and it's starting tomorrow! As a bonus, Guile & Glory: Firstborn will also be available at a substantial discount on Steam for the duration of the event!

[h3][b]Early Access 8.02 Patch Notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]Story: [/b]
Chapters 6, 7 and 8 have been added to the game, bringing the total number of story missions to 45. Chapters 1-4 have been tweaked and revised, and Chapter 5 has undergone a substantial overhaul. The final boss is also in the game, and it is TOUGH. Maybe too tough. You'll all have to play and let us know.

[b]Characters / Progression:[/b]
Full character progression has been added for the three main characters. The full roster of ten playable characters is also now available, including four story characters and six unlockable Delve characters.

[b]Delves: [/b]
Delves have been revised to offer better rewards and reduce the amount of grinding required to unlock additional upgrades. [i]Note: You can definitely beat the game without any grinding, but you will probably have to play some Delves if you want enough Glory to unlock every upgrade for every character.[/i]

[b]Dialogue:[/b] 
All in-game dialogue is now skippable! (press Escape during dialogue, the Escape again when prompted)

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b] 
Tons of bugs have been squashed, many of the menus have been tweaked and revised, and the game should run better too.

[h3][b]What's Left To Do?[/b][/h3]
The game is pretty close to being finished, but there is always room to improve. Exactly how big the changes will be remains to be seen, but below are the areas we're currently looking at improving before launch:

[b]Balance:[/b] 
I think the difficulty curve is a lot smoother now, but there's still more work to do. I'll need everyone's help to make sure that none of the bosses are too hard or too easy, and that the Boon options for characters are at least somewhat balanced.

[b]Bug Fixes / Polishing:[/b] 
This is probably what most development time will be spent on in the next few weeks. There are still a few bugs and bits of jank, especially with the audio, and fixing those as best I can will be a priority moving towards full release.

[b]Menu Design / Tutorials:[/b] 
Playing through the game, I think some of the menus and systems are still a bit obtuse, and I'll be working to make everything a little more user friendly. I'll also be working with Jessie, our wonderful artist, on a bit of visual polish.

[b]Narrative:[/b] 
The story content is currently complete, although I'll probably give it at least one more pass to make sure that everything is explained adequately, and that there aren't too many plot holes. 

[b]Delves:[/b] 
The Delves basically work and serve their purpose now, but I'd love to flesh them out a bit more with additional levels and bosses to pit your Delve heroes against. I don't know if a significant overhaul of the Delves will come before launch, or in a later patch, but I definitely have stuff in the works.

[b]Boons:[/b] 
It would be nice to add at least a few unlockable Boons for each of the Delve heroes, and I might add some more to the main characters as well. 

[b]The Lorebook:[/b] 
The Lorebook already contains a lot of useful information about gameplay mechanics and the world of Guile & Glory, but I'll be looking to add more information on status effects, the different gameplay systems, and elements of the lore not covered in detail by the story.

That's all for now. Expect small updates and bug fixes in the next few weeks as we move towards full release. Our composer Landon Walter and I also have something fun in the works, so stay tuned for updates on that. Thank you for reading, and may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be Glorious!

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Early Access 5.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Aspirants! It has been brought to our attention that we accidentally included the sixth playable character, the Bow Cyclops, in the latest update.

This character was not intended to be available until the Chapter 6 update, and was still a little buggy, so we released this patch to address the issue...

The Bow Cyclops should now be fully functional, and temporarily available to anyone who has cleared the first mission of Chapter 3. The Bow Cyclops will also be a tremendous asset against the hidden boss.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Guile & Glory: Firstborn Early Access 5.10 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Aspirants! The upcoming Chapter 6 update has required us to make quite a few changes under the hood, and this latest patch will allow us to test some of those changes before we roll out the next major update. These changes include fixes for a few significant bugs, as well as revisions to a number of the existing boss fights (including the hidden challenge boss introduced in 5.0). You can find the details below (some spoilers):

[u][b]Prepared Skills Revision:[/b][/u]
Prepared skills (such as the Rakshasa's smash attack) can now be cancelled. This is in preparation for the release of more prepared skills for player characters, and is intended to make characters with prepared skills easier and more intuitive to use.
[u]
[b]Playable Rakshasa Changes:[/b][/u]
We found a bug where the Rakshasa player character was not dealing any damage with skills while enraged. This was due to some changes that allow a character's skills to deal different damage while the character is enraged. A new Rakshasa boon has been added that makes use of this feature, but getting your hands on it will be tough!

[u][b]Guardian Valkyrie Changes:[/b][/u]
We fixed a bug where the Valkyrie boon's transposition skill was making both the Guardian and the target permanently immune to projectiles. Cool, but definitely not intended! We may, however, introduce a more balanced version of this effect in a future upgrade for the Valkyrie.

[u][b]New Boss Health Bars:[/b][/u]
We have now added support for multiple creatures sharing the same boss health bar. This will affect the early Rakshasa battles and the Swarm Vetal bosses in the Bone Wastes delve. 

[u][b]Secret Boss Changes:[/b][/u]
We have also made some changes to the hidden boss battle. We want it to be hard, but the old version was virtually impossible. With these revisions, Aspirants will at least stand a fighting chance against the mysterious monster. Defeating the hidden boss will now also net you a powerful reward...

[u][b]Secret Boss Hint:[/b][/u]
If you haven't found the secret boss yet, here's a clue. Start your search in the Bone Wastes delves. You'll find a few clues to its whereabouts, and the means of drawing it into combat.

[u][b]Demo Update:[/b][/u]
We are also bringing our demo of the game to Steam this weekend. If you haven't tried the game yet, it will offer a sample of what Guile & Glory: Firstborn has to offer.

That's all for now. Stay tuned for the new demo over the weekend, and the Chapter 6 update coming in the next week or so! Thank you for reading, and may your adventures in the Drowned Lands be Glorious!
